label: Create Content
description: Creates a node of the type the event names inside the event's target, which becomes the resource later steps act on. The type must be one listed here that the target can hold.

nameFrom.label: Name from
nameFrom.description: The fields of the event's patch the new node is named after, the first one holding text winning. None, or none with text, names it after its type.

namePattern.label: Name pattern
namePattern.description: A regular expression a name the event asks for must match. Left blank, any name a node can have.

nameHint.label: Name hint
nameHint.description: What names the pattern allows, in words, for a form to show.

types.label: Type
types.description: The node types an event may ask for, in the order they are offered.

nodeType.label: Node type
nodeType.description: The JCR node type created, e.g. "sch:Section".

label.label: Label
label.description: What the type is offered as. Left blank, the node type.

named.label: Named
named.description: Whether an event may ask for a name for content of this type. Left blank, it may.

namePattern.label: Name pattern
namePattern.description: The pattern a name asked for content of this type must match, in place of the activity's.

nameHint.label: Name hint
nameHint.description: What names this type's pattern allows, in words, in place of the activity's.
